title: Explorer Genesis dependency readiness matrix

dependencies.name: 420Indexer /v1 read service
readiness_basis: Indexer qualification evidence marks core ingestion/read API implemented and tested
Explorer consumer gate is qualified at source/CI boundary
remaining_gates: publish real testnet Indexer URL
prove deployed server exposes all Explorer-required capability routes
prove chain ID/finality/freshness on live endpoint
provide representative indexed data

dependencies.name: Explorer backend service
readiness_basis: Explorer source and consumer tests exist
remaining_gates: replace backend URL placeholder
deploy against qualified Indexer endpoint
run live testnet validator with concrete witnesses

dependencies.name: Explorer frontend/public URL
remaining_gates: publish production-equivalent testnet URL
exercise all required views against deployed backend
verify labels/finality/failure presentation

dependencies.name: canonical chain/RPC source for 420Indexer
readiness_basis: Indexer source supports required chain ID, checkpoints, rebuild and wrong-chain rejection
remaining_gates: identify official qualified testnet RPC/node source
prove runtime chain ID 420
prove head/safe/finalized and receipt/log availability

dependencies.name: ProtocolRegistry canonical contract
readiness_basis: source exists and frozen system address is 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000434
remaining_gates: verify code exists at frozen address on target network
verify runtime code hash
verify authorized Registry publications needed by Explorer
exercise direct canonical reads against Indexer projection

dependencies.name: frozen Genesis system-address authority
readiness_basis: two source maps match and freeze ProtocolRegistry/Names/Identity/Governance/Stake/consensus assignments
remaining_gates: verify target-network predeploy/code identity before treating addresses as live deployments

dependencies.name: Registry ABI/descriptor provenance for Indexer decoding
readiness_basis: contract/event definitions and service IDs exist in source
remaining_gates: produce/verify required compiled ABI artifacts for release path
bind decoder descriptors to deployed Registry/runtime provenance
test live historical/version decoding

dependencies.name: consensus/validator projection source
readiness_basis: Explorer and Indexer consensus interfaces exist in source
remaining_gates: prove deployed Indexer backend wires consensus provider
prove representative epoch/rotation/validator data
historical block-producer attribution remains a separate implementation gap from EXP-0.2.2

dependencies.name: 420 Names display enrichment
remaining_gates: none for core Explorer Genesis qualification
if enabled, verify owning protocol deployment and never replace raw address

dependencies.name: 420 Identity public-label enrichment
remaining_gates: none for core Explorer Genesis qualification
if enabled, restrict to public display data and preserve raw address/provenance

dependencies.name: verified-source metadata / 420 Verify integration
readiness_basis: Explorer profile permits verified-source presentation metadata but does not make it execution authority
remaining_gates: none for raw contract inspection
if integrated, verify metadata provenance and ensure runtime bytecode remains authoritative

genesis_blocking_rule: Only dependencies with required_for_genesis=true may block core Explorer Genesis readiness; optional enrichment absence must not block.
no_promotion_rule: No dependency may be marked deployed or live-qualified solely from source files, frozen addresses, unit tests, CI qualification, or placeholder readiness records.
